title: At the Bus Stop
text:
Tom is at the bus stop. He waits for the bus. It is cold today.

A woman comes to the stop. She says hello to Tom. The bus comes, and they get on.

questions.text: What does the woman say to Tom?
How does the woman seem to feel about Tom?
options: She knows him and is friendly

questions.text: What will Tom probably do next?

vocabulary.definition: a place where a bus stops so people can get on or off
a large vehicle that carries many passengers
having a low temperature, not warm

paragraph_translations: Том на автобусній зупинці. Він чекає автобус. Сьогодні холодно.
До зупинки підходить жінка. Вона вітається з Томом. Приїжджає автобус, і вони сідають у нього.
